name: @cyclone-ui/queue
description: Queue, the Cyclone UI AI component for an agent's todo list: Trace lines split into a section of what is left (N to do) and a section of what is done (N completed), each a collapsible line. Pass todos (id, title, description, status pending, in_progress or completed) for the default sections, or compose Queue.Section, Queue.SectionLabel, Queue.List and Queue.Item parts. Each todo shows an empty circle, a dotted circle or a check for its status, the todo in progress shimmers while isStreaming is true, a todo with a description opens to show it, and Queue.ItemAction adds an icon button.
